title: Nehemiah Bible Quiz - Chapter 4
description: Ten questions on Nehemiah 4: the builders face mockery and threats, and work with a weapon in one hand.

questions.text: Before whom did Sanballat ask, "What are these feeble Jews doing?"
questions.explanation: Nehemiah 4:2 says he spoke before his brothers and the army of Samaria.

answers.text: The king of Persia and his court
His brothers and the army of Samaria

questions.text: What did Tobiah the Ammonite say could break down their stone wall?
questions.explanation: Nehemiah 4:3 says that if a fox climbed up it, he would break down their stone wall.

questions.text: Why was the wall joined together to half its height?
questions.explanation: Nehemiah 4:6 says it was because the people had a mind to work.

answers.text: The people had a mind to work

questions.text: Which of these groups is named among those who were very angry that the repair went forward?
questions.explanation: Nehemiah 4:7 names Sanballat, Tobiah, the Arabians, the Ammonites and the Ashdodites.

questions.text: What did the builders do when their enemies conspired against them?
questions.explanation: Nehemiah 4:9 says they prayed to their God and set a watch against them day and night.

answers.text: They prayed and set a watch day and night
They stopped building for a month

questions.text: What did Judah say was fading?
questions.explanation: Nehemiah 4:10 says, "The strength of the bearers of burdens is fading, and there is much rubble."

answers.text: The light of the lamps at night
The supply of water in the city
The strength of the bearers of burdens

questions.text: What did Nehemiah tell the people to remember?
questions.explanation: Nehemiah 4:14 says, "Remember the Lord, who is great and awesome, and fight for your brothers."

answers.text: The Lord, who is great and awesome
The days of their fathers in Egypt

questions.text: How did those who built the wall work?
questions.explanation: Nehemiah 4:17 says everyone did the work with one hand and held his weapon with the other.

answers.text: Only during the night, by torchlight
In silence, without speaking a word
With their families guarding the gates
With one hand working and the other holding a weapon

questions.text: What signal were the people to rally to?
questions.explanation: Nehemiah 4:20 says, "Wherever you hear the sound of the trumpet, rally there to us."

questions.text: What did Nehemiah and his men not do, according to the last verse?
questions.explanation: Nehemiah 4:23 says none of them took off their clothes, and everyone took his weapon to the water.

answers.text: They did not take off their clothes
They did not eat any bread
They did not speak to anyone
They did not leave the temple
